stories.title: DJ Ride sobre a vitória no DMC World Championship: "Não podia haver recompensa maior. É algo que fica para sempre"
stories.summary: Portuguese DJ Ride won the Open category at the DMC World Championship at KOKO in Camden, London, with 206 points, ahead of a Japanese competitor (195) and Brazil's Anthony Garcia (188). In the interview he describes his set as "a love letter to music made in England" and worries that fewer young Portuguese DJs are taking up scratching: at DMC Iberia, three Portuguese DJs competed against 15 to 20 Spanish ones. Next year he will judge the DMC World Championship, work on an album and release a scratch vinyl. He shared the win with his Beatbombers partner Stereossauro.

stories.title: EVAWAVE estreia-se com I GOT U: "É um misto de tantas coisas, vou beber a tantos sítios"
stories.summary: Portuguese producer EVAWAVE (Eva Esteves, 39) has released her debut EP, I GOT U, on the independent collective and label Monster Jinx. She came out on her 39th birthday. The EP is instrumental and sits between electronic music and beat-driven hip hop, built on synth lines and ambient textures. She produces from scratch with synths, MIDI controllers and virtual instruments instead of sampling, and sometimes uses her voice as a melodic texture. She used to be a singer and worked in TV audio post-production.

stories.title: Berliner Club-Marathons zum Jahreswechsel 2026/27: Die Line-ups im Überblick
stories.summary: GROOVE rounds up the New Year's marathon line-ups in Berlin. They include an 82-hour 'NULL RESET' weekender at RSO.BERLIN (Freddy K, JASSS, Setaoc Mass b2b Henning Baer), a BCCO x 240KMH run at Münze with ÜBERKIKZ, future.666 and DJ Hyperdrive, a Tresor 'New Year's Week' with Richie Hawtin, Regis and FJAAK, and a 60-hour marathon at Renate with Skee Mask. Zenner bills Ricardo Villalobos and Richard Akingbehin together for the first time on 1 January. Berghain had not yet published its line-up.

stories.title: Lentekabinet: Dekmantel-Schwesterfestival kündigt Line-up an
stories.summary: Dekmantel's spring festival Lentekabinet has announced the line-up for its 14th edition, on 15–16 May 2027 at Het Twiske, just north of Amsterdam, with a permit for up to 16,000 visitors a day. Names include Apollonia, Avalon Emerson, Eris Drew & Octo Octa, Gerd Janson, Palms Trax, Raresh, Goldie, Chez Damier and Job Jobse & Spray. Steven Julien plays a hybrid set as 808 Prince.

stories.title: Primavera Sound Porto. Revelada divisão diária do cartaz de 2027
stories.summary: Primavera Sound Porto has revealed which of its 55 acts play each day of the 14th edition, 10–13 June 2027 at Parque da Cidade do Porto. Sunday 13 June is Primavera Bits, a dance-music day with Josh Baker, Cloonee, Carlita and Trikk. Saturday's headliners are FKA twigs and The Chemical Brothers, alongside Simian Mobile Disco, Shygirl and others. Passes and single-day tickets are sold only through Fever.

stories.title: "Electronic Beira Sounds" realiza-se este sábado em Viseu
stories.summary: Electronic Beira Sounds, a techno event organised by Dark Waves, takes place this Saturday at the Pavilhão Multiusos de Viseu. The lineup is Cravo b2b Vil, Du/art, Frank Maurel, Valody and Tryängle b2b VASQ. There will be a harm-reduction space and a creative hub for local artists. The event has support from Viseu Municipality, and 100% of profits go to the Associação Humanitária de Bombeiros Voluntários de Viseu.

stories.title: Ritmo Futuro celebra cinco anos de música eletrónica com festa em Faro
stories.summary: The electronic music series Ritmo Futuro marks five years with a party at Art Haus Club in Faro on Saturday 28 November, from 23:59 to 05:00. The lineup is Rick Offen, Awk and Trouble, and the night celebrates the local community built around the events. Tickets are on Shotgun.
